comment: Thresholds of the aerial roof study. Set before any hand labelling: roof and colour values a priori; canopy values by eye on the whole-cell overview (lawn vs crown statistics), before the random-point check. NIR texture is in raw 8-bit digital numbers of the NAIP scene it was set on (2023 Illinois); other scenes may need other values. Texture, opening and majority sizes are window radii (window = 2 * round(radius / pixel) + 1 pixels). Colour confidence = min(1, usable share / 0.8). minGroupN: privacy floor; a committed statistic over fewer buildings is reported as its count only.
